svg.title: LDGI (Optics Communications 2025, MATLAB): Loop differential ghost imaging corrects spatial noise asymmetry in ghost imaging with one-dimensional optical phased-array line patterns.
svg.desc: Portrait-derived decorative motif: computed Walsh-Hadamard samples 73 through 96 of the author's public portrait. Each interval is independently linearly scaled; these are not project measurements or performance. Research context: Optical validation with spatial-light-modulator-generated line patterns.
